capabilities: Convert the current note to an HTML presentation with Marp CLI and open it in the browser
Animate termlogue blocks so commands type out and output appears line by line
Keep Marp running in watch mode so edits refresh the presentation
Export the presentation as HTML next to the note inside the vault
extras: Desktop-only: it spawns Marp CLI as a separate program, which the mobile app cannot do. The user must install Marp CLI themselves; the plugin never downloads it. Generated presentations are written to the system temporary directory (except opt-in HTML export into the vault) and contain no executed code from termlogue blocks.
intentEvidence: It is the presentation half of Terminalogue, whose Obsidian plugin renders those same blocks in Reading View.
problem: Obsidian cannot turn Marp-formatted notes into standalone HTML slide decks, and slide previews cannot play animated terminal sessions on a slide.

relations.evidence: It is the presentation half of Terminalogue, whose Obsidian plugin renders those same blocks in Reading View.
converts it with Marp CLI, and opens the result in your default browser

summary: Marp-based converter that turns a Marp note into a self-contained HTML presentation with animated terminal sessions, opened in the default browser.
